description: Experimentally rank candidate texts by a Novelty Score: the harmonic mean of semantic divergence from the supplied original context and caller-assessed coherence. Returns candidates best-to-worst with per-candidate scores; it does not measure truth or validate the winner. Originally designed as the selection phase of the ANI serendipity pipeline (see graph_chaos / graph_discover).

coherence_scores.description: Optional 0-10 coherence scores for each variation (default: 8.0)

context.description: The original context/text before chaos injection

variations.description: Array of generated narrative variations to compare

name: graph_evaluate_variations
